_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Can't get an appointment
categories.description: No GP/doctor slots, 8am scramble, long booking lead times.

categories.name: Waiting lists & ER waits
categories.description: Long waits for specialists, surgery, A&E/ER.

categories.name: Medical bills & surprise charges
categories.description: Surprise bills, out-of-network charges, unclear costs.
keywords: medical bill|hospital bill|surprise bill|itemi[sz]ed|out of network|balance billing|cost of (surgery|delivery|treatment|mri|scan)

categories.name: Hospital overcharging & deposits
categories.description: Private hospitals overcharging, package rates, advance deposits.

categories.name: Insurance & public scheme coverage
categories.description: Coverage denials and scheme confusion (Ayushman, CGHS, Medicare, Medicaid).

categories.name: Medicines, prescriptions & shortages
categories.description: Drug prices, shortages, refills, pharmacy problems.

categories.name: Dental care access & cost
categories.description: Can't find a dentist, high dental costs.

categories.name: Quality of care & negligence
categories.description: Misdiagnosis, negligence, rude staff, poor care.

categories.name: Mental health access
categories.description: Long waits and costs for therapy and psychiatry.

categories.name: Reports, records & admin
categories.description: Test results, records, certificates and discharge paperwork.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Parent or caregiver
personas.description: Seeks care for a child or relative.
